title: Retain physical topology and each edge law across future interventions
statement: A finite exact history plus multiple proposed boundary operating points is source-claimed realizable iff internal node potentials and edge flows satisfy Kirchhoff conservation and each edge shared anchored secant-slope constraints. Sorting sampled drops on each edge yields linear inequalities; their complete disjunction is a finite union of polyhedra,retaining one common constitutive law across history/futures rather than fitting unrelated responses. Source gives grounded Kron sector sandwich alphaK0<=HessianPhi<=betaK0 and K0-whitened inverse-sector constants m=(alpha+beta)/2,a=(beta-alpha)/2<m, connecting inherited N1028 at its stated regularity/grounding scope. Generic smooth-convex interpolation is a larger response class and cannot replace actual topology. In a grounded three-edge star with slopes[1,5], observed currents(.2,.2),voltages(.3,.3),future currents(.2,.4) give sharp first-voltage interval[.34,.50]. The grounded-edge current increases.2; upper slope5 forces hidden potential rise>=.04,and unchanged first edge current fixes its drop. Source reports constructed endpoints and a conservative smooth-strongly-convex surrogate permitting.26 via a rational inverse-energy assignment passing six inequalities. Analytic star bounds are source-reported exact; LP reproduces interval and a four-edge nonlinear cyclic test is reported. Underlying note,assignment,code/results are not received; no new independent whole acceptance or execution.
